name: Jagannath Temple
title: The Holy Citadel of Puri Rath Yatra
description: A highly sacred coastal temple complex dedicated to Lord Jagannath, globally famous for its monumental annual Chariot Festival.

name: Mahabodhi Temple
title: The Cradle of Buddhist Enlightenment
description: Located in Bodh Gaya, this ancient pyramidal stone temple marks the exact location where Siddhartha Gautama sat beneath the sacred Bodhi Tree and became the Buddha.

name: Statue of Unity
title: The Tallest Statue in the World
description: Standing at an engineering height of 182 meters, this colossal monument honors visionary statesman Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

name: Jyotisar Kurukshetra
title: The Birthplace of the Bhagavad Gita
description: A deeply revered historical site featuring a holy ancient Banyan tree, where Lord Krishna delivered his timeless cosmic sermon to Prince Arjuna.

name: Morni Hills
title: The Lone Scenic Hill Station of Haryana
description: A peaceful offshoot of the Shivalik hill range, hosting rich greenery, twin interconnected holy lakes, and historic fort ramparts.

name: Kangla Fort
title: The Historic Royal Palace of Imphal
description: An ancient fortified palace complex that served as the traditional seat of power for the Meitei rulers of the Kingdom of Manipur.
